use default

use Cells = LIST[int]

let unknown = -1

clues_of(text: string) -> List[List[int]] =>
    text.split([' '])
        |> map(word =>
            word |> map(c => cast int(c) - 64) |> collect_list())
        |> collect_list()

arrangements(clues: List[int], length: int) -> List[long] is
    let found = LIST[long]()

    place(i: int, start: int, mask: long) is
        if i == clues.count then
            found.add(mask)
            return
        fi

        let rest =
            clues
                |> skip(i + 1)
                |> map(n => n + 1)
                |> reduce(0, (a, b) => a + b)

        for at in start::length - clues[i] - rest do
            let block = ((1L << clues[i]) - 1L) << at

            place(i + 1, at + clues[i] + 1, mask | block)
        od
    si

    place(0, 0, 0L)

    found
si

class PUZZLE is
    rows: int
    columns: int
    lines: List[List[int]]
    choices: List[List[long]]

    init(row_clues: List[List[int]], column_clues: List[List[int]]) is
        rows = row_clues.count
        columns = column_clues.count

        lines =
            (0..rows)
                |> map(r => (0..columns) |> map(c => r * columns + c))
                |> cat(
                    (0..columns)
                        |> map(c =>
                            (0..rows) |> map(r => r * columns + c)))
                |> map(line => line |> collect_list())
                |> collect_list()

        choices =
            row_clues |> map(clue => arrangements(clue, columns))
                |> cat(
                    column_clues |> map(clue => arrangements(clue, rows)))
                |> collect_list()
    si

    propagate(cells: Cells) -> bool is
        let changed mut = true

        while changed do
            changed = false

            for (k, line) in lines |> index() do
                let filled mut = 0L
                let empty mut = 0L

                for (j, cell) in line |> index() do
                    if cells[cell] == 1 then filled = filled | (1L << j) fi
                    if cells[cell] == 0 then empty = empty | (1L << j) fi
                od

                let fits =
                    choices[k]
                        |> filter(a =>
                            a & empty == 0L /\ a & filled == filled)
                        |> collect_list()

                if fits.count == 0 then
                    return false
                fi

                let always = fits |> reduce(-1L, (a, b) => a & b)
                let ever = fits |> reduce(0L, (a, b) => a | b)

                for (j, cell) in line |> index() do
                    if cells[cell] == unknown then
                        if always & (1L << j) != 0L then
                            cells[cell] = 1
                            changed = true
                        elif ever & (1L << j) == 0L then
                            cells[cell] = 0
                            changed = true
                        fi
                    fi
                od
            od
        od

        true
    si

    solve(cells: Cells) -> Cells? is
        if !propagate(cells) then
            return null
        fi

        let open = cells.index_of(unknown)

        if open < 0 then
            return cells
        fi

        for guess in [1, 0] do
            let attempt = Cells(cells)

            attempt[open] = guess

            if let solved = solve(attempt) then
                return solved
            fi
        od

        return null
    si

    show(cells: Cells) is
        for r in 0..rows do
            write_line(
                (0..columns)
                    |> map(c => cells[r * columns + c])
                    |> map(cell => if cell == 1 then "#" else "." fi)
                    |> join(" "))
        od
    si
si

let text = IO.File.read_all_lines("nonogram_problems.txt")

let problems =
    (0..(text.count + 1) / 3)
        |> map(i => (rows = text[3 * i], columns = text[3 * i + 1]))
        |> collect_list()

for (number, problem) in problems |> index() do
    let puzzle = PUZZLE(clues_of(problem.rows), clues_of(problem.columns))
    let size = puzzle.rows * puzzle.columns
    let start = repeat(unknown, size) |> collect_list()

    write_line("problem {number + 1}: {puzzle.columns} by {puzzle.rows}")

    if let solved = puzzle.solve(start) then
        puzzle.show(solved)
    else
        write_line("no solution")
    fi

    write_line("")
